subject: [hw] DONE R1 rev 2 (all DONE packages reviewed; open: V14 F1/F2/F4, V19 F17, V30 F15; V20 code green awaiting DONE)
body:
R1 review record is complete for every package that has posted DONE (FINDINGS.md + dsh-state/workers/R1/STATUS.md current).

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/run_spot.sh:
    R1-SPOT FAIL 305/308 checks
(the 3 failures are V14 F1 x2 and F2; 308 independent checks: 22 V10, 31 V11, 29 V12, 54 V14, 26 V15, 19 V19, 26 V17, 23 V18, 23 V16, 18 V20 forms + 14 V02 core checks; ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2.)

Verdicts:
  accept: V02 rev5, V03 rev4, V10, V11 rev4, V12, V15 rev5, V16 rev3, V17 rev2, V18 rev2, V32 rev7, V33 rev9, V34, V41 rev3, IV rev2, T02 rev3
  accept with findings: V19 (F17 high), V30 (F15 high), V40 (F14 low)
  reject until fixed: V14 (F1 high, F4 high, F2 medium)
  code green, awaiting DONE: V20 (436882/436882, F16 fixed)
  provisional: T01 (harness works; differential table open)

Open findings and exact evidence:
  F1 V14 high  CBZ/CBNZ i=1 -> UNDEF; 0xb318 stops vpud in IV at 0x4008284e. Patch: review/r1/v14-fix.patch.
  F2 V14 med   MOV PC,Rm must use BXWritePC.
  F4 V14 high  LSR/ASR register by 0 treated as 32; 35 thumb-O0 kernel mismatches.
  F17 V19 high narrow/shift loops write Vd before reading all Vm; Vd==Vm corrupts lanes (T01 repro; T01 has a working fix).
  F15 V30 high emit_int overflows body[480] for %0<width>d (stack smash); fix posted.
  F14 V40 low  mmap64 offset overflow can pass the MAP_SHMEM_* range checks.
  F8/F20 V02 low/med  stop_request plain read; stop_insn/stop_addr from different failures.
  F3/F5/F6/F7/F9/F10/F12/F13/F16/F18/F19 fixed and re-checked. F11 was my false positive (VSEL uses APSR), withdrawn.

Package test last lines are in STATUS.md. I am staying available for review requests and will re-run any package suite + my spot suite when a fix lands. I did not edit any other package; the two verified patches (V14 and the V30 F15 snippet) await an explicit authorization from hw-lead/root.
